steps.what: Show stored measures for sustainability programs
Sign the program evaluation for this period

outputs: filed copy of signed program evaluation v1

tasks.design: A job shows stored program measures in {BI}. The officer monitors and evaluates whether the sustainability programs are effective. A later job files the signed evaluation in {DOCS}. A model does not declare a program a success.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program measures were copied into a fresh pack before anyone could judge them.
tasks.enabler_now: The measures already sit on the ledger.
tasks.still_hard: Effectiveness can turn on a result the measure does not capture.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides whether the program is working.

ambition.what: Evaluate a program the week its measures are posted.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the judgement, not on copying measures.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a recurring review is a dashboard on the ledger, and Digest [S2] says unprepared data gives inaccurate answers, so every cited number is checked against stored rows.
The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Configure the existing ledger view before a new store.
unknowns: Who else must sign an evaluation.
research_questions: How often a program has no stored measure.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining evaluation time is still the officer's judgement.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes measures are missing. The high end assumes measures are posted on the ledger. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set strategies for energy, waste, and buildings.

steps.what: Total stored energy use and waste amounts
Develop strategies for resource conservation and recycling
Execute strategies for transportation and building design
Sign the strategy for pollution and education

outputs: filed copy of signed strategy note v1

tasks.design: A job totals stored energy use, waste, and pollution figures in {ERP}. The officer develops and executes the strategy for resource conservation, recycling, waste elimination, transportation, education, and building design. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not change a building or a route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Energy and waste figures were retyped before a strategy meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Those amounts are already on the operations record.
tasks.still_hard: A strategy can be right on the numbers and still fail on the site.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides the strategy and what will actually be executed.

ambition.what: Review energy and waste totals before the strategy meeting, from the ledger.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the strategy, not on retyping the totals.

reach.task: Carry out only the signed strategy

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a recurring review is a dashboard on the ledger, and Digest [S2] says unprepared data gives inaccurate answers, so every cited number is checked against stored rows.
The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Energy and waste figures come from stored rows, not from a generated estimate.
Configure the existing operations record before a new store.
unknowns: Which sites have usable energy rows.
Who can change a building design.
research_questions: How often a waste amount is estimated rather than measured.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining strategy time is still the officer's decision.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes rows are estimated. The high end assumes rows are measured and stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop the measures the monitor will hold
Show the configured monitor from stored rows

outputs: filed copy of signed monitoring definition v1

tasks.design: The officer develops, or oversees, the sustainability evaluation and monitoring measures. A configured view in {BI} shows only stored rows. A later job files the signed definition in {DOCS}. No new store is added before the existing one is configured.
tasks.previous_blocker: Monitoring was a fresh sheet each quarter, merged by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: The ledger can show the measures the officer names.
tasks.still_hard: A measure can be available and still be the wrong one.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what is monitored.

ambition.what: Open the monitor from stored rows the week the definition is signed.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the measures, not on merging sheets.

reach.task: Keep the view to the signed measures
reach.learn: Which rows the monitor may show

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a recurring review is a dashboard on the ledger, and Digest [S2] says unprepared data gives inaccurate answers, so every cited number is checked against stored rows.
Digest [S3] is a vendor case the digest treats as integration rather than a model, so this design does not use that timing as its own saving.

assumptions: Configure the existing planning view before a new system.
The view does not invent a missing amount.
unknowns: Whether a site cannot supply the row.
research_questions: How often a requested measure has no source row.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining design time is still the officer choosing measures.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes few measures have a source. The high end assumes most measures already have a source. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List sustainability project tasks already stored
Supervise employees working on sustainability projects
Supervise volunteers on the same projects

outputs: filed copy of signed supervision note v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored project tasks in {PROJECT}. The officer supervises employees and volunteers on the sustainability work. The list is tasks, not a score of a person. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project status was collected by asking each person, which can become a performance watch.
tasks.enabler_now: The project record already lists tasks.
tasks.still_hard: Supervision still depends on the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what help the project needs.
tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week with the people, not scoring them.

reach.task: Update the task the note names

evidence.claim: Digest [S10] says staff performance monitoring is high-risk, Digest [S14] limits a solely automated decision, and Digest [S15] requires works-council consent for performance tools, so this design does not score employees or volunteers.
The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Configure the existing project list before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether volunteers are in the project record.
Who employs the people being supervised.
research_questions: How often a task has no owner.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining supervision time is still the officer with the team.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes tasks are poorly listed. The high end assumes tasks are already on the project record. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The sustainability officer spends the week on the strategy, the risk, and the signed text. A total from stored rows and filing that text can move. No model approves a project or scores a person.
reach: A supplier receives only the report version the officer signed.
A project lead starts only from the proposal the officer approved.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no row in the ledger.
Check whether a reporting duty applies before a report is called a filing.
role.ambitious_version: A signed impact report can go out the same week, and the officer still holds the text.
